facts.fact: Decreto-Lei n.º 3/2025 (republishing Lei 38/VIII/2013, art. 41) requires offices outside the central service to register social pension applications in the 'aplicativo informático' used to manage the pension within 24 hours, and art. 47 enters approved pensioners in the database of the non-contributory pensions system, run by the CNPS.
